classification_rules.unattended_standalone: Ordinary separate browser process with public UI actions and actual publisher download event; no CUA/operator intervention. Must bind execution receipt to bytes and parser intake.
classification_rules.operator_assisted: Ordinary connected browser publisher download, then portable local intake. Codex/CUA-assisted validation demonstrates operator workflow; never reclassified as unattended.
classification_rules.blocked_or_unqualified: Challenge/rate-limit/permission/generation/download failure or absent export evidence. Initial403 is a bounded negative observation, not permanent denial.
classification_rules.browser_print: Browser Print/Save as PDF artifact, distinct from publisher-generated download; no browser-print used as legal export proof.
